summary: original_bytes (on every envelope shape internal/mcp/bound emits) means the byte length of the JSON bound.go itself received as input -- after whatever field stripping/verbose-toggle stripping/select projection the caller already applied, before bound.go's own truncation -- never the raw upstream API response size. A regen must keep this documented at the point original_bytes is computed so the semantics don't need re-deriving from live measurement again.
reason: Live testing that depends on original_bytes for cost-model measurement found its meaning ambiguous: a select-projected call read a small original_bytes (post-projection size) while an unprojected call read a much larger one (pre-projection, pre-bounding size) on the same underlying data, and both were technically correct under different unstated readings of the field. This is a documentation-only fix (no behavior change) recording the one definition both cases actually satisfy.
